verses.harfu-t-ta-i-tabibi-qaribun-hal-siqamiya: ṭabībī qarību hal siqāmiyā tasmaʿu yuqābilunī yawmī l-muqaffā l-mushaffaʿu
ʾarānī ʾidhā mā jiʾitu yawmā muḥammadā taḥḥaqaqa ʾāmālī kamā ʾatawaqqaʿu
muḥammadu khayri l-ʿālamīna wasīlatī ʾatāka khadīmu ḍāriʿu yatashaffaʿu
ʾataytu biṣinwī thumma ʾahlī waʾildatī sirāʿā waḥawla l-hāshimī natajammaʿu
wakhalfī jumūʿu yantamūna liḥizbikum yaʿʿumuhumu t-tashfīʿu ʾajmaʿu ʾaktaʿu
ʾayā nafsu ʾadrakti l-ʾamānī fahadhihi marābiʿu khayri n-nāsi wan-nūru yasṭaʿu
faʾalqat ʿaṣāhā wāstaqarrat bihā n-nawā wanilti l-munā mā bal- ʿaynika tadmaʿu
wamā bal- hadhā sh-shawqi wash-shamlu jāmiʿu wadhā l-ḥablu mawṣūlu famā l-waṣlu yumnaʿu
falaw ṣawwarūnī fī l-ḥaqīqati lam yaraw siwā shakhṣi maḥbūbi bihi natamattaʿu
fabāʿithu ʾibrāhīma lish-shawqi wāḥidu falastu ʾuthannīhi walam ʾaku ʾajmaʿu
wahuwa l-muṣṭafā khayru l-khalāʾiqi ʾaḥmadu bihi qūtu rūḥī ʿindahu l-qalbu yakhshaʿu
ʿakaftu ʿalā bābi n-nabiyyī muḥammadi waman rāma ḍurrī fahuwa ʾajdā waʾanfaʿu
bimakkaha bil-masʿā bikhayfi wamashʿari ḍiyāʾu rasūli llāhi liṭ-ṭarfi yalmaʿu
bighāri ḥirāʾi bil-muḥaṣṣabi lā ʾarā rafīqā siwā l-hādī bihi ʾatamattaʿu
muḥammadu ʿabdu llāhi ʾaḥmadu ʿāqibā biḥḥubi l-ʾimāmi l-hāshimī ʾatashabbaʿu
ʿalayka ʾamīna llāhi nāṣiru ḥāmidā bashīru nadhīru māḥiyā l-kufri ʾarwaʿu
makkayyu wayā maʾamūnu ḥibbī wamarkazī fama fī siwā hādī l-barriyyati ʾaṭmaʿu
ʾayā jamīʿa l-khayrāti yā maljaʾa l-warā faṣilnī biḥabli lā yurā yataqaṭṭaʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu faʾinna fuʾādī ʿindaka d-dahra ʾajmaʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu faʿayshu bidūni l-ḥubbi fīka muḍayyaʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu liqāʾu kaḥaswi ṭ-ṭayri lil-qalbi mūjiʿu
wayawmu kaʾalfi min sinīna ʾaʿudduhu qaṣīrā famā nafsī bidhalika taqnaʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu ʿalā raghmi ʾanfī bis-salāmi ʾuwaddiʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu wahal baʿda hudhā kullihi sawfa ʾarjaʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu madā d-dahri dīna l-muṣṭafā l-qawmi ʾarfaʿu
ʿalayka ṣalātu llāhi thumma salāmuhu maqāmuka maḥmūdu ladā l-ḥashri tashfaʿu
